title: Impute missing values in meteorological data — impute
text: v_y Character vector variable names (quoted strings) impute. NULL (default), variables data table except site time selected imputation. mm metamet object containing observation data (dt), quality control codes (dt_qc), optional reference data (dt_ref). method Character string specifying imputation method use. NULL (default), method read imputation_method column dt_meta. Supported methods: "time" Generalized additive model (GAM) smoothing splines     time hour day. Suitable variables strong diurnal/seasonal patterns. "regn" Linear regression covariate x. Fits model     excluding missing values, predicts. "era5" Substitute ERA5 reanalysis data dt_ref.     fewer n_min observations, replaces directly without fitting. "noneg" Replace negative values zero (physical constraint). "nightzero" Replace nighttime values zero. Uses site coordinates     (lat, lon) identify day/night via openair::cutData(). "zero" Replace missing/flagged values zero. qc_tokeep Integer QC code(s) indicating "good" "raw" data retain unchanged. Default 0. Data QC codes qc_tokeep candidates imputation. k Integer. Smoothing basis dimension GAM "time" method (default: 40). Automatically reduced data sparse. Controls temporal smoothness. fit Logical. TRUE (default), fits regression/GAM models imputation. FALSE, uses direct substitution (useful "era5" method minimal data). n_min Integer. Minimum number non-missing observations required fit model (default: 10). fewer observations exist, "time" "regn" methods skip imputation; "era5" method switches direct substitution. x Optional. Character string naming covariate column data table use "regn" method. example, x = "PPFD_IN" regress photosynthetic photon flux density. lat Numeric. Latitude site degrees (default: 55.792). Used "nightzero" method calculate sunrise/sunset times. lon Numeric. Longitude site degrees (default: -3.243). Used "nightzero" method calculate sunrise/sunset times. plot_graph Logical. TRUE (default), generates diagnostic plots showing observations, reference data (available), QC flags. title: Impute missing values in meteorological data — impute
text: **Imputation Process:** function iterates variable v_y. variable: 1. Determines imputation method (parameter metadata). 2. Identifies rows impute based QC codes is_selected flag. 3. Applies selected imputation method. 4. Updates QC table flag imputed values. 5. Optionally generates diagnostic plot. **Minimum Data Handling:** fewer n_min non-missing observations exist: - "time" "regn" methods skip variable (imputation). - "era5" method switches direct substitution (fit = FALSE). - methods ("zero", "noneg", "nightzero") unaffected. **Data Reference:** function requires metadata table (dt_meta) describing variables, optionally reference table (dt_ref) ERA5 reanalysis data.
